title: b7z9.25.5: Python+Rust: wire hold-off completion to desync/rejoin FSM
description: Spec 02a.5.3 R-02a-043: after hold-off 3 superframes, MUST initiate desync+rejoin. Python advance_holdoff()==True is only a signal (slot_coordination.py:359-376); Rust same pattern (multi_instance.rs:1108-1122). Neither wires the signal to DesyncFSM. Fix: when advance_holdoff() returns True, call desync_fsm.force_desynced() or equivalent to trigger the rejoin path.
